title: BLADE: Better Language Answers through Dialogue and Explanations
abstract: arXiv:2604.03236v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based educational assistants often provide direct answers offering little incentive for students to explore or engage with course materials. We present BLADE (Better Language Answers through Dialogue and Explanations), a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) based conversational assistant grounded in course-specific content that guides students toward relevant materials through citation-grounded dialogue rather than delivering unsourced solutions. We evaluate BLADE in an advanced undergraduate NLP course with extensive instructional resources, where locating and synthesizing relevant material is a central challenge. translated_title: BLADE：通过对话与解释获得更好的语言答案
translated_abstract: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的教育助手通常提供直接答案，这几乎不激励学生探索或参与课程材料。我们提出了BLADE（通过对话与解释获得更好的语言答案），这是一种基于检索增强生成（RAG）的对话助手，以课程特定内容为基础，通过引用依据的对话引导学生获取相关材料，而不是提供无来源的解决方案。我们在一个拥有大量教学资源的高级本科NLP课程中评估了BLADE，在该课程中，定位和综合相关材料是一个核心挑战。在测验期间，学生被分配到三种条件之一：仅使用BLADE、仅使用直接课程材料，或两者兼用；我们测量了表现和资源使用情况。结果显示，当两种资源都可用时，学生始终选择BLADE而非直接材料，并且测验表现更高。
tldr: BLADE通过基于引用依据的对话引导而非直接答案，显著提升了学生在高级NLP课程中的测验表现，且学生更倾向于使用它。
en_tdlr: BLADE improves quiz performance in an advanced NLP course by guiding students through citation-grounded dialogue instead of direct answers, and students consistently prefer it over direct materials.
